{{Quote|I've heard your name around the pilot's lounge a few times. What can I do for you?|Captain Rikkh|<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>}}
'''Rikkh''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] was was a member of the [[Corellian Security Force]] with the [[Military rank|rank]] of [[Captain/Legends|captain]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He lived in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and was an acquaintance of [[Rhea]].
